reference_verbalizer_ids.scope: reference checkpoint only (autotrust/JEV-27B, vocab 248320); NOT valid for the local serving checkpoint

score_rubrics_origin: declared experiment default; the corpus carries bare levels 0..5 only

semantic_serialization.encoding: JSON, keys sorted, compact separators, UTF-8, non-ASCII preserved, no trailing newline

qwen_chat_v1.provenance: Chat representation only: messages must be rendered by the real tokenizer's chat template (chat_template.jinja of the pinned serving checkpoint). No token ids are assumed or synthesised in this repository.

tokenization.note: Training and serving must tokenize through this one path; token ids are recorded from the actual tokenizer, never synthesised.
